content.title: Record-Breaking Indie Series “The Amazing Digital Circus” From Glitch Productions Heads to U.S. Theatres with Fathom Entertainment for ‘The Last Act’ Finale June 4-7 - Fathom Entertainment
content.text: Published by on Apr 10, 2026 8:00 AM Record-Breaking Indie Series “The Amazing Digital Circus” From Glitch Productions Heads to U.S. Theatres with Fathom Entertainment for ‘The Last Act’ Finale June 4-7 Viral Hit Animated Web Series Comes to the Big Screen for the Worldwide Premiere of the Epic Series Conclusion Tickets On Sale Now FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE Sydney and Denver – April 10, 2026 – Glitch Productions, global leader in independent animation, and Fathom Entertainment, the leading specialty distributor of worldwide theatrical content, is bringing the long-awaited worldwide premiere of the “last act” of the worldwide hit animated web series phenomenon, “The Amazing Digital Circus,” to U.S theatres nationwide and other countries from June 4-7, 2026. Created by Gooseworx, “The Amazing Digital Circus,” has surpassed 1 billion online views following its 2023 debut and was one of the top 5 most-viewed Netflix shows globally in first two weeks of October 2024, 12 months post initial release (source: Netflix). In the long-awaited conclusion and series finale, “The Amazing Digital Circus: The Last Act” combines recently released episode eight with episode nine, an all-new, hour-long final episode for fans to witness first in theatres. “The Amazing Digital Circus: The Last Act” features a beloved cast of characters with voice actors including Lizzie Freeman as Pomni (Pokémon Horizons), Alex Rochon as Caine (Poppy’s Playtime), Michael Kovach as Jax (Murder Drones, Lackadaisy), Amanda Hufford as Ragatha (Genshin Impact), Marissa Lenti as Gangle (Borderlands 3), Sean Chiplock as Kinger (The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild), Ashley Nichols as Zooble (Lackadaisy) and more. “The Amazing Digital Circus: The Last Act” features music composed by series’ veteran Evan Alderete (Hazbin Hotel) and art direction from Gobo3D. Kevin Lerdwichagul, CEO of Glitch Productions, said, “Glitch Productions is proving itself as the ultimate disruptor to the traditional animation industry with ‘The Amazing Digital Circus.’ Offering an alternative online distribution model that bypasses corporate oversight, maintains creative freedom and uplifts passionate, thought-provoking and visually-striking projects, we are thrilled to partner with Fathom and bring ‘The Amazing Digital Circus: The Last Act’ to fans the series finale on the big screen across the U.S. in theatres nationwide.” “‘The Amazing Digital Circus’ has had a remarkable and organic rise in popularity these past couple of years, with an unparalleled fanbase that is yearning for its dramatic conclusion of the hit animated web series. Fathom is thrilled to partner with Glitch and bring the long-awaited episode nine series finale to theatres,” said Ray Nutt, Chief Executive Officer at Fathom Entertainment. “Fathom continues looking for the most compelling theatrical content – regardless of format – and is leading the industry in redefining consumer expectations for what is possible on the big screen.” Tickets for “The Amazing Digital Circus: The Last Act” are available now online and at participating theatre box offices (theatre locations are subject to change). For more information, please visit Fathom Entertainment. “The Amazing Digital Circus: The Last Act” Synopsis The viral internet sensation “The Amazing Digital Circus” comes to its long-awaited conclusion in a feature-length theatrical release! This “Last Act” combines episode eight with the all new, hour-long episode nine for fans to see before anyone else in the world. With Caine gone and the circus dark, the cast are left with only the mistakes and traumas of their pasts to keep them company. As the prospect of eternity closes in around them, they discover the truth about the Digital Circus and its history. Will they come to terms with what they uncover, or will they make… the other choice? Also, presumably at some point someone says something funny, because this ending can’t be THAT depressing, can it? About Glitch Productions Founded in 2017 by brothers Kevin and Luke Lerdwichagul in their Sydney, Australian garage, Glitch Productions was started with a singular goal: change the way the west creates teen and young adult animation. The company has grown massively since that beginning, now with many shows under its belt with more coming, and hundreds of millions of global fans. Now, as one of the largest web animation studios in the world, Glitch lives and breathes online content and its shows are expertly crafted to attract large audiences in the online landscape. About Fathom Entertainment Fathom Entertainment is the leading global specialty distributor of content to movie theatres. For more than 20 years, Fathom Entertainment has pioneered theatrical distribution of events and special engagements across various genres and formats, including feature films, episodic content, documentaries, concerts, and live events. Fathom consistently ranks among the top 10 theatrical distributors in North America, and distributes content to cinemas worldwide. Fathom Entertainment is owned by AMC Entertainment Inc. (NYSE: AMC), Cinemark Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: CNK), and Regal Cineworld Group (LSE: CINE.L).
